Centre Considers NEET Exam Reforms, Informs Supreme Court

The Indian central government has informed the Supreme Court that it is considering significant reforms to the NEET examination process. This includes exploring a shift to a computer-based testing format and a two-stage examination structure, similar to the JEE. A panel has been formed to review the NEET-PG admission process and examine issues related to cut-off reductions. The government stated these measures are being taken to enhance exam security and prevent unfair practices, awaiting a report from a task force on public examination systems.
